name: Steam Link
description: Eye and expression tracking from Steam Link OSC.

en-US: Connect the headset through Steam Link and start SteamVR.
Enable eye and face tracking sharing and OSC output in Steam Link / SteamVR.
Set the OSC output port to 9015, or make it match the plugin listenPort if you changed that setting.
If the plugin reports a port error, close the other program using that port or choose the same free port in Steam Link and this plugin.
zh-CN: 通过 Steam Link 连接头显并启动 SteamVR。
在 Steam Link / SteamVR 中启用眼部与面部追踪共享，以及 OSC 输出。
将 OSC 输出端口设为 9015；如果修改了插件 listenPort，两处端口应一致。
如果插件提示端口错误，请关闭占用端口的其他程序，或在 Steam Link 和插件中选择同一个空闲端口。
